chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch.79: The Market Fair – Naming the Fool & Gold for Guokui
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang names the Fool "Gao Zhijian," turns Gouwa into "Cao Cao," and buys guokui flatbread at a bustling mountain market. The calm before Mount Henghua.
